QuestInfo.name: Resurrection of Osiris
QuestInfo.0: The ancient god Osiris is in need of your assistance for his resurrection.
QuestInfo.1: Holding on to Isis's Empty Bottle for 30 minutes will automatically fill up with Resurrection Elixir of Isis.\nYou can use the Elixir to extend the duration on the Osiris Shoulders, and succeeding 14 times will grant you a permanent one.
